findings.title: Preserve recorded calls when deriving a contextual test logger
findings.body: LoggerMiddleware now writes request-completion logs through logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...). This implementation returns a fresh TestLogger whose records are inaccessible to the caller, so the supplied fake's InfoLogs remains empty even when a request is logged. Tests using that fake can no longer observe or assert request logging. Return the existing fake or make the contextual child share its recording storage.
